pages.text: The alley snow began to melt. A little squirrel had moved in next door.
Gugu wanted a snowball fight, with two on each team.
The little squirrel watched by the wall. Gugu stood between the friends. "Just us."
Gugu made snowballs. The others made theirs too.
Gugu and Nono were one team. Kiki was the other.
Two against one! Kiki could not keep up. The game kept stopping.
Gugu stood holding a snowball. It was hardly a game at all.
Grandpa Badger asked, "How many do you need for even teams?"
Gugu went to the wall. "Want to join us?"
Four players, two on each team. Snowballs flew without a pause.
